name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 5 visits over 33 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 33 hours starting 2026-06-13, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.79 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
